_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Special Inspection Equipment Concept
summary: The Special Inspection Equipment Concept details design, performance, calibration, and accuracy requirements information used for screening and approval of recommended SIE prior to design and fabrication.
use_relationship:
a. The Special Inspection Equipment Concept details design performance calibration and accuracy requirements information to be used for screening and approval of recommended SIE prior to design and fabrication of the SIE. It is used in design control to screen each proposed design against the procuring activities' existing inventory of equipment to satisfy the requirement; maintain management control over the efforts of the contractor in the area of inspection equipment; and assure integration of design of acceptance inspection equipment.
b. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement delineated in the contract.
c. This DID may be used when the provisions of ISO 9001 apply to the contract. This document may be obtained from www.iso.org
